journeys.title: Read / Focus
journeys.description: Open a recipe, resolve flagged or dense reading states, move into Cooking Focus, and protect rare destructive actions.

nodes.title: Default Recipe View
nodes.summary: Compact recipe identity, corrected-B action band, bounded Ingredients, and readable Instructions.

nodes.title: Dense flagged recipe
nodes.summary: Long metadata, no cover, many tags and collections, partial nutrition, and unresolved import flags remain controlled.

nodes.title: Long reading content
nodes.summary: Long title, 48 ingredients, 38 steps, dense metadata, and multi-paragraph notes preserve scanning and position.

nodes.title: Flagged first entry
nodes.summary: Import Info auto-opens once for a flagged imported recipe, then stays dismissed for the visit.

nodes.title: Manual recipe
nodes.summary: A non-imported recipe keeps Default View and Media available without exposing import-only information.

nodes.title: Cooking Focus
nodes.summary: Simplified reading context retaining title, cooking facts, ingredients, instructions, notes, and primary actions.

nodes.title: Cooking Focus with long steps
nodes.summary: Focus remains a reading/execution context when instructions and notes require extended scrolling.

nodes.title: Delete recipe confirmation
nodes.summary: Recipe deletion remains an Overflow-only irreversible action with a blocking confirmation.

journeys.title: Edit / Save
journeys.description: Work in one recipe-level draft, validate Basics and Ingredients, protect exits, and keep unfinished sections visible without inventing their behavior.

nodes.title: Edit Basics
nodes.summary: Continuous desktop editor with two-zone Basics, one recipe draft, and one global save outcome.

nodes.title: Edit Ingredients
nodes.summary: Compact rows retain reorder, optional Quantity, fixed Unit, required name, and draft-only removal.

nodes.title: Failed-save validation
nodes.summary: Linked error summary, rail counts, field messages, and focus recovery form one recovery path.

nodes.title: Unsaved changes guard
nodes.summary: Blocking desktop dialog with Save, Discard, and Cancel when navigation would abandon the recipe draft.

nodes.title: Edit Instructions — unfinished
nodes.summary: The section is present as continuity context; editing, validation, and stable step identity remain unapproved.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; do not infer an editor or reorder interaction from the map.

nodes.title: Edit Cooking notes — unfinished
nodes.summary: The section is reserved in the continuous editor; field meaning and validation remain unapproved.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; issue #78 owns the missing field contract.

nodes.title: Edit Nutrition — unfinished
nodes.summary: Estimated nutrition remains a reserved section with no approved completeness or validation behavior.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; issue #77 owns the missing nutrition contract.

nodes.title: Save request in progress — unfinished
nodes.summary: The single global Save boundary is known; request progress and disabled-action treatment are not designed.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; do not infer loading copy or retry behavior.

nodes.title: Save success — unfinished
nodes.summary: A successful global Save outcome is reserved for later design; navigation and feedback are not prescribed here.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; the map does not promise a toast, redirect, or persistence contract.

nodes.title: Save failure — unfinished
nodes.summary: A failed request remains in the Edit context; server-error copy and retry behavior are not designed.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; validation and concurrency contracts must be resolved before a final state is designed.

journeys.title: Resources / Media
journeys.description: Inspect media and import provenance, expose destructive resource boundaries, and locate adjacent unfinished workspaces.

nodes.title: Media panel
nodes.summary: Read-only images and understandable cooking links occupy the shared auxiliary slot.

nodes.title: Expanded media preview
nodes.summary: Selecting a thumbnail expands one image preview without turning Media into an asset-management workspace.

nodes.title: Import Info
nodes.summary: Review flags and grouped primary/derived resources without duplicating the recipe page.

nodes.title: Flagged and ignored resources
nodes.summary: Conflicting source facts, ignored media, and extraction confidence remain visible with grouped provenance.

nodes.title: Cascade removal confirmation
nodes.summary: Affected resources are explicit, the current cover is protected, and saved recipe content remains unchanged.

nodes.title: Import review cleared
nodes.summary: The panel remains in place after review while the source hierarchy stays visible.

nodes.title: Manage Media — unfinished
nodes.summary: A separate media workspace is reserved; upload capacity, cover replacement, removal, and save/cancel behavior are not approved.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; issue #75 owns the missing media-management contract.

nodes.title: Organize Recipe — unfinished
nodes.summary: Collections, tags, and related organization work remain an adjacent workspace rather than an invented Core screen.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; issue #76 owns the selector and assignment contract.

nodes.title: Cover selection — unfinished
nodes.summary: The map preserves the open question of embedded cover selection versus a narrower picker entry state.
nodes.scopeNote: Placeholder only; no final picker hierarchy or mutation lifecycle is implied.

warnings.title: Import review mutation contract disagrees
warnings.details: Approved Design uses Mark all reviewed while the verified production audit records current per-flag PATCH behavior. Core does not choose a winner.

warnings.title: PR #80 delivery state disagrees
warnings.details: Current Recipe Detail scope still calls PR #80 draft while the live GitHub snapshot records it merged. #91 owns canonical roadmap/tracker reconciliation; Core preserves the contradiction.
